name: worktree-subagent-pipeline
description: Sequential worktree-subagent pipeline for pl-829f: each step's agent works in an isolated git worktree cut by the harness. GOTCHA: the provisioner cuts worktrees from a stale commit (old main tip), NOT the current k8s-migration tip — every agent must 'git reset --hard k8s-migration' (or --ff-only merge) before starting, and verify a sentinel file from the previous step exists. Merges back are then clean fast-forwards. Also: agents' bash cwd can drift to the shared checkout — enforce absolute paths rooted at the worktree.
